overview: This enum selects the fixed quick-chat line that a ChatDataTable row displays and speaks for a character.

None.simple: This sentinel marks that no quick chat line is selected.
None.technical: Declared as the uint8 default for FGameDataTableRow_Chat and absent from the exported ChatDataTable. GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex maps it to slot -1. Guarded display paths reject that slot. Customization paths index Id_ChatText before the start of the array.

Greeting_1.simple: This line greets the other fighter and starts the interaction.
Greeting_1.technical: Stored in the uint8 enum at value 1. GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex maps it to slot 0 in the parallel Id_ChatText and Id_Voice arrays. The exported English wording opens with a greeting, and Chat_Up maps to CHAT_001 by default. The exported row is CHAT_001 in the Conversation category and is enabled for battle shortcuts, the lobby list, the situation overview list, and the interval list.

Invalid.simple: This reserved marker represents an invalid quick chat selection.
Invalid.technical: Declared as uint8 value 255 in the enum header and absent from the exported ChatDataTable. GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex maps it to slot 254. No traced consumer selects or compares this value, so behavior beyond that arithmetic is unresolved.

notes: The export has one ChatDataTable row for every usable label from Greeting_1 through FightCarefully, with no row for None or Invalid.
GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex converts the uint8 label to a zero-based CharacterChat array slot by subtracting one, so None gives -1 and Invalid gives 254.
The slot selects parallel Id_ChatText and Id_Voice entries. Display paths use IsValidIndex. Several customization paths index Id_ChatText directly.
Chat message requests store the label byte in Category. The battle and result message widgets copy the label there.
The eight paired *_Out rows reuse the preceding text ID and carry a separate voice ID in every exported character row.
Default direction shortcuts map Chat_Up to CHAT_001, Chat_Down to CHAT_033, Chat_Left to CHAT_003, and Chat_Right to CHAT_038.
Verified entries have a traced ChatDataTable row and a traced shared consumer path, including the label minus one array lookup.
No retail Blueprint assets were inspected, so Blueprint-only behavior is not asserted.
